NewsArticle.Title: Return to Mileth Threshold
NewsArticle.Content: Some restricted areas repel you. For example: You may not equip a weapon and enter the Glioca's Temple, Goddess of Compassion. For another example: only a Rucesion Citizen may enter the Rucesion Political Commons. As of 10:30 a.m. PDT, these repulsions will return you, instead, to Mileth Threshold. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
